$comment: The leagues' combo boss drops (Wiki: Raging_Echoes_League#Combo_boss_drops and Demonic_Pacts_League#Combo_boss_drops, read 2026-11-23): 'boss drops that required multiple regions dropped as completed'. Applied by plugins/modes/league/ComboDrops.LeagueMode.js to a league character on the rollers' loot ('npc-drops:roll' and 'drops:rolled'), when the item's `leagues` (5 Raging Echoes, 6 Demonic Pacts) holds the character's league. `part` and `finished` are cache gamevals. A part is replaced wherever it drops, unless `npcs` names the NPCs it is replaced from (the hydra tail also drops from ordinary hydras, which the pages leave out). A finished item drops as one, whatever the part's stack (ours: the Colosseum's 2-3 echo crystals give one pair of echo boots). Left out: 'All of The Forgotten Four dropped all pieces of the soul reaper axe' (not a swap), and Raging Echoes' repaired Volcanic Mine dragon pickaxe and tormented synapse conversion (not drops of a part).
